find_adsorbate_binding_sites: run find_adsorbate_binding_sites to search for adsorbate binding sites on surfaces of a bulk material using the OCP API
wait_for_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: run wait_for_adsorbate_slab_relaxations to block until all relaxations in a system have finished
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_results: run get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_results to fetch relaxation results for a given system ID with retry logic
Lifetime_enum: review the Lifetime enum to choose between SAVE, MARK_EPHEMERAL, or DELETE for relaxation data retention on API servers
AdsorbatesException_hierarchy: review the AdsorbatesException class hierarchy including UnsupportedModelException, UnsupportedBulkException, and UnsupportedAdsorbateException for error handling
